title: kb-reconciler output
description: Canonical machine-readable output contract for the kb-reconciler role. See agents/kb-reconciler.md for the prose contract this mirrors.

pairsReceived.description: Count of contradiction pairs received in the dispatch prompt.

codeDecided.description: Count of pairs whose winner was determined by reading the merged code.

tierDecided.description: Count of pairs where the code was silent and the trust-tier tiebreak (CONFIRMED > INFERRED > UNVERIFIED) decided the winner.

deferred.description: Count of pairs left flagged: active user-directives, or genuinely undecidable (same tier, code silent).

resolutions.description: Every pair actually resolved via kb_resolve_contradiction, code-decided or tier-decided alike.

evidence.description: For code-decided wins: a real file path + symbol actually read. For tier-decided wins: the trust-tier tiebreak reasoning.

deferredPairs.description: Pairs left flagged, unresolved, with a reason.

reason.description: "active-directive" or an explanation of why the pair stayed undecided.

bibleCommitted.description: The committed value returned by kb_export's result after Step 8.
